questions.text:
I'm in my room. Her phone has been face-down on the couch for ten minutes and I've already stood up twice.
A few months ago she told me someone saw my boyfriend Eli with another girl. She wouldn't say who. 💔
Who did she say saw them?

Tamsin. We sat next to each other at crits all term.
That night Shay sat on the edge of my bed and held up her phone, and I just stopped breathing.
What bar was he supposedly at?

Oh my god. I even mailed her a birthday card. 🥲
Eli kept saying he was at her party that night. I told him that was very convenient.
So where was he actually that night?

He was telling the truth the whole time. And I blocked him.
But Tamsin swore to me in the hallway. She looked straight at me. She had no reason to lie, unless someone gave her one.
What did Shay give her for saying so?

That's what I was worth. A night out. 😤
In May she told me she couldn't split groceries anymore because money was tight.
How much did that cost her?

And I bought her pizza that week because she said she was broke.
Right after that, the studio went quiet. Nobody saved me a desk at crit. Shay said people were talking about me and I should give them space. So I did.
What's the group they all moved to?

I'm not in it. Of course I'm not.
She set that up, and then she sat on the bathroom floor with me while I cried about being left out.
How many things has she told people about me?

onboarding.text: I'm Priya. Second-year architecture master's, Cleveland. Shay Okafor is my roommate, the desk next to mine at studio, and since April, honestly, my only friend. She just went for a run without her phone.
onboarding.label: Priya

onboarding.text: In April Shay showed me proof that my boyfriend Eli was cheating. I ended it that night. A few weeks later she told me the studio group had been talking about me, so I stopped going.
onboarding.label: Priya & Shay

onboarding.text: Since then it's been my room, my laptop, and Shay bringing me ginger tea. In June I won a fellowship. I'm so tired lately that I've been thinking about giving it back.
onboarding.label: Shay

onboarding.text: Something doesn't add up, and I can't trust my own judgment right now. So you look. Tell me what my only friend really says about me. She'll be back in twenty minutes.
onboarding.label: Priya

msgs.text: Good morning my daughter. I woke up thanking God for you
Good morning Mama. Thank you. Did the light come back?
Yes, since yesterday evening. Mrs. Bello brought us moi moi
Please greet her for me
I will. Are you eating well? Your voice sounded thin
I'm eating Mama. I made jollof on Sunday, it'll last all week
Good. Put fish inside, not only rice
Yes ma 😂
Psalm 121 for today. The Lord shall keep your going out and your coming in
Amen 🙏🏾
Your cousin Chidi says he saw you looking tired at the market
He exaggerates. I was carrying heavy bags
Rest your body my dear. Studies will not run away
I will rest this weekend, promise
Your father's memorial anniversary is next month. We will do the small mass
I know, Mama. I'll light a candle here and call during the mass
That will warm his heart wherever he is
I miss him
We all do. He would be proud of you. Very proud
Good morning. Tobe said he will call you today. Pick up o
Morning Mama. I'll pick up, I promise
Good morning my dear. Did you eat before you left the house?
Good morning Mama. Yes, I had cereal.
Cereal again? Eh eh. Cook rice and stew, it will last you.
I did that last weekend, Mama. There's still some 😄

Good. Mrs. Bello says hello. Her knee is better.
That's wonderful news! Send her my congratulations
Tell her I'm glad. Is the generator fixed?
Yes, the man came. Only 2 days of light today but God is faithful.
Amen. I'll call you after studio.
Don't stay too late in that building. Take the bus, no walking in the dark.
I always take the bus. Promise.
Good morning my daughter. I prayed for you at 5 o'clock. How was your sleep?
Did you buy your bread and tea like I said? Do not suffer in that cold place
Good morning my dear. God is faithful. Have you eaten?
The Lord keeps you. Psalm 121.
It's August Mama, it's hot here 😂 I bought plenty of tea
Good morning Mama ❤️ I slept a little. Studio was late.
You are always in that studio. Are you eating? Real food, not noodles.
I cooked jollof on Sunday. Enough for the whole week 😄
Very good. Did you put enough pepper? Americans don't know pepper.
Yes Mama, my tongue is still burning
Hahaha. Mrs. Bello says hello. Her son is getting married in December.
Tell her congratulations from me!
The generator was bad again last night. NEPA took the light for many hours.
Ah, I'm sorry Mama. Is the neighbor still sharing diesel?
Yes yes, we manage. God is faithful.
Amen. I'll call you Sunday after my run.
Okay my dear. Drink water. Don't carry the whole world on your head.
I'll try Mama. Love you ❤️
Love you more. Goodnight when it reaches you.
Good morning Mama. Yes, I made jollof on Sunday, there's plenty
Good. Don't be sleeping late. Studio is not worth your health
I won't, Mama. How is your knee?
Better. Mrs. Bello brought pepper soup. I am praying for your exams, Nne
Thank you Mama ❤️ I'll call Sunday
Thank you Mama ❤️
Your cousin Chidi sent photos from his naming ceremony. Beautiful baby.
I saw! Sending him a message now.
Good morning Mama, I just saw the voice note. Beautiful prayer 🙏🏾
Good morning my dear. Have you eaten?
so proud of you 🌿 you earned every bit of it
still processing. dinner's on me tonight
no, I'm cooking. jollof, you're not allowed in the kitchen
made ginger tea. it's on your desk, drink it before it goes cold
thank you. you're the only person who checks on me
Oat milk is almost gone. Adding it to the list?
Already on it. Dave's after crit.
You are a saint.
A saint with a coupon 😄

I'll text Mr. Dominguez tonight. Don't run it until he looks.
I made tea. It's on the counter, left side. Don't let it go cold

I'll make another 😊
Made tea. There's a cup on your desk. The green one.
You're the best 🫶 I'm in the model shop till late

Yes, I'm 4 to 5. I'll bring the file on the drive.
Do we have any oat milk left

Okay. Thank you. I'll pay you back
Don't worry about it. Did you sleep?
Define sleep
Come on. Lights off by 1, I'll knock on your door if not
Fine. Goodnight Shay
Left rice and stew in the fridge. Take some.
Thank you. I'll eat it standing up like a civilized person.
can I tell you something? I think I might give the fellowship back. I'm so tired

ok. thanks for being the one person I can say it to
Bin day is tomorrow, by the way.
On it. Going out for a run, will take it down first.
Hello Shay, the building will have the water shut off on Wednesday from 9 to noon for pipe repair.
Ms. Okafor, the plumber is coming tomorrow between 9 and noon to fix the kitchen faucet. Someone needs to be home.

Also the hallway light on your floor is being replaced, my guy comes Friday.

Hi Shay, friendly reminder that August rent is due August 1. Thank you! - Mr. Dominguez

Also the buzzer repair is scheduled for next week
Great, thank you. It's been broken since spring
I know. Parts were delayed
Understood
Thanks Mr. Dominguez, Priya's half is on its way and I'll send mine in a couple of days
Hello Mr. Dominguez, the dishwasher is leaking at the bottom door. Could someone look at it?
Thanks for letting me know. I can send Carl tomorrow afternoon.
That works. Priya or I will be home after 4.
Carl will come between 4 and 5.
Your kitchen faucet is still dripping? I can send him then too.
Yes please, it's been a slow drip for weeks
Noted. He will bring a new washer.
Thank you!
The plumber finished. Please let me know if there are any leaks

Reminder the hallway gets repainted next week. Please keep it clear of bikes and boxes
Will do
Carl was just here, says the hose is cracked. He is ordering a new one.
Thank you. Should we avoid using it until then?
Yes please, hand wash for a few days.
Will do.
Reminder: the building will have the water shut off in two days from 10 to noon for pipe work.
Noted, thanks for the warning.
Haven't seen yours yet, please send when you can.
So sorry, sending tonight
Also the back stairs light is out again on our floor. Not urgent.
I'll put it on Carl's list.
Trash pickup is a day later than usual this week because the truck is in for repairs
Thanks for the heads up
New dishwasher hose is in. Carl will install it tomorrow morning.
Great, I'll make sure someone is home. Thank you.
are you booking the laser tomorrow? the sheet fills up by 9

ok I'll take 4 to 6 then. we can share a hot coffee run between
deal ☕
my section drawing looks like soup. can you look at it?
it's 2am Mei. send a pic

yes. line weights are probably the problem. thicken the cut lines
oh. that's so obvious. thank you 😭
Prof Ibarra moved the crit to 10am. did you see?
no!! thank you. I was going to print at 9
Sable opens at 8. you'll make it
how did your crit go?
better than expected. Ibarra liked the courtyard idea. said my circulation is 'quietly confident'
that's a compliment from him!
mine was a bloodbath lol. he said my massing was 'a decision not yet made'
ouch. you'll fix it. let's do lunch, I'll treat you to a slice
you don't have to
it's a slice, Mei 😂
ok ok. Tony's at 1
do you have an X-Acto spare? mine is dull and the store is closed
yes, there's a pack in my drawer. take the whole thing
you're the best. I'll replace it
also the summer desk reshuffle list is up. you're two rows over from me now
ugh, that's by the window with no outlet
I have an extension cord. you can have it
hero 🙌
are you running tonight? I want to start, but I'm scared of the hill
I go along the lakefront, it's flat. 6:30. I'll go slow
ok. don't judge my pace
never. we walk the hard parts
That was actually fun?? my legs are dead but I'm happy
same time next week then 😊
Are you still up for ramen tomorrow? I found a place near campus with student pricing
Yes! What time?
Seven? I'll book
Seven is good. I'll finish the section drawing before
Ambitious
Hopeful
That was so good. We should do it every week
Every week is dangerous for my budget 😂 every other week
Deal. Biweekly ramen club
Chair of the club: you
Shay are you going to the lecture this week?
Yes, I'll save you a seat
Thanks! I'm bringing onigiri, want one?
Yes please!! Tuna if you have it
Tuna mayo, coming up 🍙
Did you finish the structures problem set?
Almost. Number four is killing me
Same. Want to compare after the lecture?
Yes, library table by the window
Perfect. Also your sketch of the Terminal Tower was so good!
Aw thank you Mei
See you there
printing boards at Sable tomorrow, want me to grab yours too?
yes please, I'll Venmo you for it tonight
Reading list for the fall seminar just dropped. Eight books
Eight?? In two weeks?
Library has most of them
Library desk, here I come
Hi, I'd like to book the laser cutter for tomorrow afternoon, about two hours
Hi Shay, tomorrow has 2:00 to 4:00 open. Want it?
Yes please
Booked. Reminder: bring your own material or buy from the desk. No acrylic without a pre-approved file.
Chipboard only, thanks
Your slot starts in 30 minutes. Please check in at the desk.
On my way
Hi, is the 3D printer on level 2 free next week?
Printer 2 is down for maintenance for a few more days. Printer 3 has slots.
Printer 3 tomorrow morning please, for a small site model

That works
Reminder: the lab closes early tomorrow for a staff meeting, last booking 3:00.
Thanks. Does that include the model shop side?
Model shop has its own hours, check with Ray.
I left a roll of tape and a steel ruler at station 4 yesterday. Did anyone turn it in?
We have a steel ruler in the lost bin with initials S.O. on it.
That's mine 🙏 I'll come get it today
Desk is open until 7.
Thank you!
Lakeshore Fab Lab: your laser cutter reservation for 2:00 PM tomorrow is confirmed. Bay 2.
Thanks, confirmed on my end.
Reminder: bring your own material or purchase at the desk. No MDF over 1/4 inch.

Chipboard is fine. No acrylic with film on it.
Got it, thank you.
Notice: Bay 2 will be down for a lens clean in two days. Bookings moved to Bay 3.

That 2:00 PM slot is followed by another booking. We can offer a 1:30 PM start instead.
1:30 works. Please switch it.
Done. Booking updated to 1:30 PM to 3:00 PM.
Fall semester lab safety refresher is required for all returning students. Sessions open next week.
How long is it?
About forty minutes. Sign up on the portal.
Will do, thank you
Your cut was left on the bed. Please collect leftover pieces.
Sorry! Coming back now.
No problem. Desk closes at 8.
Reminder: your next reservation is in two days at 11:00 AM, Bay 3.
Thanks. Is there a student rate for the 3D printer yet?
Not yet. Check the board in the lobby.
Will do.
Shay, can you send me the updated section drawings before the review? PDF is fine.
Yes, Professor. I'll send them tonight, I'm still fixing the stair detail.
Good. Also your model base reads a bit heavy. Try thinner chipboard.
Understood, I'll rebuild it. I can use the 1/16 basswood.
Basswood works. Don't over-polish it.
Sent the PDF to your email, 14 pages 🙏🏾
Received. Good progress on the courtyard section. Let's talk about circulation tomorrow.
Is my slot still 2:30 for the mid review?
Moved to 3:15. Dr. Okoye is joining as guest critic.
Thank you for telling me. I'll update my calendar.
Your board layout is cluttered. Fewer words, more drawing.
Noted. I'll cut the text blocks by half and enlarge the elevation.
Good. Print one A1 test before the final run.
Will do. Sable Print Shop has a student rate.
Do you have a minute at the studio today? I want to see your site model.
Yes, I'm at my desk until about 5.
On my way.
Thank you for the feedback today. The ramp idea is clearer now.
The ramp is the strongest move you've made. Keep it.
Reminder: summer reading response is due next week. Two pages.

Yes, chapter three only.
Laser cutter booking is full until late next week. Any workaround?
Ask Ray at the model shop about the evening block. Tell him I said so.
Will do, thank you!
Your reading response was thoughtful. Slightly overlong. Fine.
Thank you, Professor. I'll trim next time.
Are you free to help hang boards for the open house this Saturday morning? Paid in pizza.

Bring tape and a level.
Shay, can you send me the updated section drawings before the pin-up at the end of the week?
Yes, Professor. I'll upload them tomorrow morning.
Good. The lighting studies were strong last time.
Thank you, that means a lot.

Rest tomorrow. You look tired.

Reminder that the crit room has changed to 204.
Thanks for the heads up. I'll tell my row.
Office hours are moved to 3 PM today if you want to talk through the facade.
I'd like that. I'll bring the tracing paper study.
Perfect.
See you then.
Do you have the Rhino file for the section cut template? I lost mine
Yes, sending to your email
Check Lakeshore mail not Gmail

Also is the laser cutter on level 2 broken again or is that just me

I'll tell them you're dramatic

Quick one. 1/8 inch basswood or chipboard for the massing model?
Chipboard for massing, basswood only for the final. Basswood is expensive
Everything's expensive. Do you know anyone selling leftover sheets

Ray hates me since the glue incident
Ha. Tell him you'll sweep
Sacrificing my dignity for wood. Fine
Coffee at the studio café? I'll buy, I owe you for the template
Okay. Ten minutes
Iced oat latte for you right?
Just a regular drip, small. Thanks
Noted, no frills
Prof. Ibarra moved the desk crit earlier, to the start of next week. Did you see
Just saw. Thank you. That's two days less than I wanted
Same. I haven't even started the elevations
Start with the north one, it's the simplest. Then copy the line weights across
You're so organized it's scary

Vibes don't print at 36 by 48
Printing tomorrow, are you using Sable or the school plotter?
Sable. Cheaper per board and no queue
Ok going Sable then. Want to walk over together? I'm going at ten

Bringing my own tube this time. Last time I carried them like a bouquet 😂
I remember. You looked like a bride
Never again
do you still have the structures notes from spring
Yes, scanned. Sending to your email
thank you thank you
Don't lose them this time 😅
i'm printing a section model tomorrow, the plotter line is long
Go early, before 10. Lines are shorter
smart. coffee after?
Café at noon
plotter jammed again lol, i'm going to live here
Bring snacks and a sleeping bag
Did Ibarra post the crit order yet?
Not yet. Probably tonight
I hope I'm not first. Can't face it
You'll do great. Your section drawings are gorgeous
Stop, you're making me blush. Coffee run?
I'm skipping the café today, too pricey. I have tea at my desk
I'll bring you one. My treat
You don't have to!
Already ordered. Oat latte?
Thank you Dhruv 🥹
Good morning Shay. Your Uncle Segun here. How is school?
Good morning Uncle! School is going well, thank you sir
That is good. Remember, discipline and prayer. Your father would be proud
Thank you Uncle 🙏🏾
Are you eating well? You are too thin on the video call
I am eating Uncle, I promise. I cook jollof in bulk
Good. Do not live on noodles
Lol, only sometimes
I am sending greetings from Ibadan. The family is planning a small celebration in September. Chidi will explain
He told me already, I will record a message for you
That is kind. Do not make it long, I get shy
30 seconds, Uncle. Short and sweet
Shay, please send me your address in Cleveland again. I want to post you something small
Uncle, you don't need to send anything
Do not argue with your elder 😄
Okay Uncle. I'll email it so I don't mix up the apartment number
Good. Email is better
Thank you Uncle. I appreciate you
Shay, good morning. I hope school is going well.
Good morning Uncle. It's going fine, thank you. Very busy.
Good, good. Study hard. Education is the one thing nobody can take.
Yes Uncle.
Did your cousin Funmi reach you? She wants advice about studying abroad.
Not yet. Give her my number, I'll gladly help.
I will. She is thinking about Canada.
Canada is cold but the schools are good. I'll tell her about applications.
Thank you. Remember the family in your prayers.
Always.
I saw the picture of your drawing on Instagram. Very nice, very neat.
Thank you Uncle! It's the old courthouse downtown 😊
You will be a great architect. Build me a house in Ikeja one day.
Deal. A big one with a veranda 😄
Shay, how is your school going? Your mother says you are working hard.
Good afternoon Uncle. Yes sir, it is going well. Busy semester.
Good. Education is the only inheritance nobody can take. Keep it up.
Thank you Uncle. I appreciate it.
My football team won again yesterday. You should have seen it 😄
Congratulations Uncle! Greet Aunty for me.
God bless your studies. Greet your roommate for me
God keep you. Greetings from your Aunty.
Greet her for me, Uncle. Thank you.
I will. Her name is Priya, she's lovely
